verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents SSH-based file transfer ('Transfer files without exposing your data') and a 'copy data' step in the CLI quickstart, plus persistent Volumes and a CLI/API/SDK for automation, but there is no evidence of S3-compatible endpoints or built-in cloud-storage sync — data movement is left to generic SSH/rsync-style tooling. Community feedback also flags friction with persistent disks over time (vast-ai-comm-6), reinforcing that data transfer is workable but not streamlined. missing for 10: S3-compatible storage endpoints, native cloud-storage sync (e.g. rclone/S3 integration), independent hands-on confirmation of transfer performance/reliability.
